content.text:
Submitted.

**Final proposal (fallback level, § 3.2 / p0040):**
1. **Replace:** "at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term" → "at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term" (house style retained).
2. **Insert after p0040:** "Customer's non-renewal notice window under this Section 3.2 is no more than 60 days." — this puts the checklist requirement itself into operative language, which the earlier numeral-only edits did not do to the verifier's satisfaction.

**Element coverage:** the ≤60-day non-renewal window is addressed by both operations; the 5% renewal price cap is not engaged, since renewal is expressly "for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term" on existing terms (already_met, quoted from p0040).

**Preserved:** mutual "either party" notice right, writing requirement, per-Attachment structure, and the end-of-term anchor. § 13.1's unilateral price-change right (with its fee-free Customer exit) remains a change-of-terms matter, not double-flagged here. Renewal-term length still mirrors the prior term — a preferred-level point; if any Service Option Attachment runs longer than 12 months, escalate to fix the renewal term at 12 months to avoid automatic multi-year renewals.
